roles.name: Landless Knight
roles.blurb: A sword that fled a lost field on the continent. Doors still open to steel.

roles.name: Physician
roles.blurb: Trained at a plague-struck university. You know how a sickness moves.

roles.name: Ruined Merchant
roles.blurb: You got out with a strongbox and little else. Coin still talks.

roles.name: Deserter
roles.blurb: You slipped away from an army already dead on its feet. Quick hands, quicker exits.

roles.name: Friar
roles.blurb: You fled a burning monastery with your faith intact. The Church's word still carries.

roles.name: Journeyman Smith
roles.blurb: Your workshop is ash; your hands and your craft remain.

backgrounds.name: Fallen Noble
backgrounds.blurb: Your house was sacked, but the name still turns a head and the purse still has weight.

backgrounds.name: Runaway Villein
backgrounds.blurb: A serf who ran when the lord's lands burned. Strong back, longer memory.

backgrounds.name: Far-Traveller
backgrounds.blurb: From distant lands — you read a strange town faster than its own folk do.

backgrounds.name: Plague-Orphan
backgrounds.blurb: It took everyone but you. Light-footed, and very hard to rattle.

backgrounds.name: Guild Journeyman
backgrounds.blurb: Apprenticed young — a trade in your hands and an ear for a town's gossip.

backgrounds.name: Camp-Follower
backgrounds.blurb: Raised among armies: handy, watchful, and used to the very worst.
